item.text: The point fails physically: “above the Δ” is not the relevant threshold for this channel. For \(p\eta\), EXCLURAD reports \(W_\text{thr}=1.4861\) GeV, so \(W=1.45\) GeV cannot produce the requested final state; it is also below the η lookup-table range. I’m recording a refusal without silently shifting \(W\).

item.text:
Refused the request. For η production, the relevant \(p+\eta\) threshold is \(W=1.4861\) GeV, so \(W=1.45\) GeV is physically impossible despite being above the Δ resonance. It is also outside the η lookup-table coverage.
